output.reason: Company regulation setting payroll rules that affect the PPh 21 calculation for its workers. It sets employer JKK at 0.54%, JKM at 0.30% and health insurance at 4% of monthly wages, and directs that these employer-paid contributions are excluded from employees' gross income for PPh 21. This departs from the statutory treatment, under which employer-paid JKK/JKM premiums are added to gross income. It also confirms that the employee's 2% JHT and 1% JP contributions are deductible.
